To find stationary points, first take the derivative of the function, dy/dx. Set the derivative equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values are the locations of the stationary points. Then, substitute each x back into the original function to find the corresponding y-coordinates. Finally, classify each point as a maximum, minimum, or saddle point using the second derivative test or inspection of the graph.
